datasets.name: Indian Railways Stations Master Directory
datasets.source_organization: DataMeet Open Data Initiative / Indian Railways NTES
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0
datasets.description: Complete directory of 8,990+ Indian Railway passenger and freight stations, including official station codes (e.g. NDLS, HWH, BPL), full station names, railway zones (NR, WR, NCR, etc.), state jurisdictions, and geographic coordinates.

datasets.name: Indian Railways Train Services Master Registry
datasets.source_organization: DataMeet Open Data Initiative / Indian Railways Public Timetable
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0
datasets.description: Registry of 5,200+ scheduled Indian Railway train services, including train numbers, commercial names (e.g., Rajdhani Express, Shatabdi Express, Mail/Express, DEMU), origin and terminus station codes, operating railway zones, route distances (km), scheduled departure/arrival times, and operating days.

datasets.name: Indian Railways Train Halts & Route Schedules
datasets.source_organization: DataMeet Open Data Initiative / National Train Enquiry System (NTES)
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0
datasets.description: Large-scale operational schedule database (~14 MB) containing intermediate station stops, scheduled arrival and departure times, day counts, and sequence indices for Indian Railway trains. Enables precise detection of train movements through any given track section.

datasets.name: Trunk Corridor Section Traffic Density Indices
datasets.source_organization: KAVACH BIE Data Engineering Pipeline (Derived from Real Schedules)
datasets.source_url: https://data.gov.in/ (Ministry of Railways / CRIS Schedule Synthesis)
datasets.license: Derived / Open Government Data License - India (GODL)
datasets.description: Computed hourly traffic frequency and section occupancy density indices across critical trunk railway corridors (e.g. New Delhi - Mathura - Agra, Agra - Jhansi - Bhopal, Howrah - Asansol - Mughalsarai). Derived directly from 5,000+ scheduled train movements.

datasets.name: Indian Railways Trunk Corridors & Track Block Sections
datasets.source_organization: KAVACH BIE Data Engineering Pipeline (Derived from Stations & Schedules)
datasets.description: Relational mapping of contiguous inter-station track block sections along major high-density routes, tracking section lengths, electrification status, and double/quadruple track indicators.
